candidates.statement: SCOPE AND ORGANISATION 1 The M4Q(R2) guideline establishes the location and structure of quality information for 2 registration applications of all medicinal products for human use. It supports various 3 submission types, including those referring to or consisting of master files, and applies to both 4 initial marketing authorisation and post-approval submissions. This guideline is structured to 5 be flexible to accommodate all types of medicinal products and their components. 6 The applicant should consult applicable ICH and regional guidelines, including those for 7 master files, to determine the appropriate sections and content for their specific product. Any 8 non-applicable sections should be left out. Illustrative examples included in the guideline are 9 meant to further clarify location of potentially relevant content but are not exhaustive and 10 should not be interpreted as requirements. 11 The M4Q(R2) structure is presented in a globally harmonised format with sufficient granularity 12 to facilitate digitalisation and organised for easy access, analysis, and knowledge management. 13 This granularity also supports inclusion of information from emerging concepts, such as 14 advanced manufacturing, use of structured data management processes, artificial 15 intelligence/machine learning, bioinformatics, and advanced analytical tools. The applicant 16 should include applicable information on these tools within the relevant sections of the dossier 17 pertinent to their specific application. Novel processes or technologies that directly impact 18 product quality may be described in greater detail to ensure clarity and comprehension. 19

candidates.statement: ICH M4Q(R2) Adapted from ICH Q3A(R2) Specification A list of tests, references to analytical procedures, and appropriate acceptance criteria which are numerical limits, ranges, or other criteria for the tests described.
